tagline: BelOMO取景器相机，1967 年发布
description: BelOMO于1967年推出的取景器相机。配备Industar-69 28mm f2.8.。快门速度1/30-1/250s + B。使用18x24mm frames on 35mm。

specs.英文简介: Chaika 2 (cyrillic: ЧАЙКА-II) was a half-frame 35mm viewfinder camera produced by the Belomo factory in Belarus, then in the USSR, between 1967 and 1972.
